title: poa cerealis
intro: Poa cerealis, commonly known as meadow grass or wild rye, is a type of plant belonging to the Poaceae family. This grass is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Poa cerealis include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and support sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
